title: PREP exercise record
description: Written record of an oil spill response plan exercise: type, date, description, objectives and results, the 15 Appendix A core components and lessons learned, with a self-certification block for the plan holder's authorized representative. Page 1 holds identification, description, worst case discharge and countermeasures, participants (up to 8) and objectives (up to 11); page 2 holds the 15 core components, the evaluation, up to 5 lessons and the certification.

planHolder.description: The plan holder (fictional in an exercise)

exerciseDate.description: Date and time of the exercise

examples: Corbin Valley operations center, Conference Room B

cyclePosition.description: Where the exercise falls in the exercise cycle
examples: Year 2 of the 3-year cycle that began 01/01/2025 (ends 12/31/2027)

description.description: Short description of the scenario and how the exercise ran
examples: A release from Line 4 into Harlan Creek, 20 miles above a municipal water intake.

worstCaseDischarge.description: Whether the exercise simulated a worst case discharge scenario, and which
examples: Yes: the plan's worst case discharge for the river crossing segment (2,800 barrels).

countermeasures.description: Countermeasures named in the plan and whether this exercise covered each

objectives.description: Objectives from the guidelines for this exercise type and the result of each

result.description: Met, Partially met, Not met or Not evaluated

exercised.description: Yes, No or Not applicable to the plan

evidence.description: Which injects or decisions exercised it
examples: NRC report record; notification decision at 0912

evaluation.description: Self-evaluation: whether objectives were met and how that was judged
examples: Facilitated review by the exercise design team; objectives A to I met except F.
The after-hours call list was out of date.
I certify that this exercise was conducted as described, that its objectives were evaluated, and that this record is accurate.

certifierName.description: Authorized representative: name and title (leave blank to sign by hand)
examples: D. Alvarez, Director of Emergency Response
Keep this record and the exercise materials for three years at the location named in the plan.

edition.description: Edition of the guidelines the objectives follow
examples: Objectives follow the 2016 PREP Guidelines, version 2016.1
